# Ending Support in 2005 - Microsoft Lifecycle | Microsoft Learn

![](/en-us/lifecycle/media/search.png) Please go [here](/en-us/lifecycle/products/) to search for your product's lifecycle.

The following list represents products retiring or reaching the end of support in 2005. Upon retirement or end of support, there will be no new security updates, non-security updates, free or paid assisted support options or online technical content updates. Go [here](/en-us/lifecycle/overview/product-end-of-support-overview) to learn about Fixed and Modern Lifecycle policies and service packs.

If you have any questions regarding support for a product, please contact your Microsoft Account Representative. If you need technical support, visit the [Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/contactus/?ws=support) website.

## Products reaching End of Support

The following products and releases, governed by the [Fixed Policy](/en-us/lifecycle/policies/fixed), will end support in 2005.

| Product | End of Support |
| --- | --- |
| [Office XP, Service Pack 2](/en-us/lifecycle/products/office-xp?branch=live)[SharePoint Team Services 1.0, Service Pack 2](/en-us/lifecycle/products/sharepoint-team-services-10?branch=live) | March 9, 2005 |
| [Exchange Server 2003](/en-us/lifecycle/products/exchange-server-2003?branch=live) | May 25, 2005 |
| [Microsoft Office OneNote 2003](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-office-onenote-2003?branch=live) | July 26, 2005 |
| [Microsoft Office 2003](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-office-2003?branch=live)[Microsoft Office Project 2003](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-office-project-2003?branch=live)[Microsoft Office Project Server 2003](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-office-project-server-2003?branch=live)[Visio 2003](/en-us/lifecycle/products/visio-2003?branch=live) | July 27, 2005 |
| [Windows XP](/en-us/lifecycle/products/windows-xp?branch=live) | August 30, 2005 |
| [Microsoft Systems Management Server 2003](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-systems-management-server-2003?branch=live) | September 10, 2005 |
